claims.claim: SpaceX added a 100 mph speed limit to Starshield terminals used by Ukrainian forces overnight between 13 and 14 October 2026.
claims.episode_span: The change caused multiple drone missions to lose connectivity and abort without prior notice to operators. claims.source_title: SpaceX Restricts Ukraine’s Military Starlink Access, Disrupting Drone Operations Amid Growing US Tensions
claims.supporting_quote: Ukraine’s armed forces have reported serious disruptions to drone operations after Elon Musk’s SpaceX introduced new restrictions on its Starshield satellite communications service overnight on 13–14 October.

claims.claim: Serhiy Beskrestnov confirmed the Starshield speed restriction and noted no advance warning was given to Ukrainian forces.

claims.claim: A single Starship stack carries roughly 5,250 tonnes of methalox at the 3.6-to-1 oxidizer-to-fuel ratio.
claims.episode_span: A single Starship stack carries roughly 5,250 tonnes of methalox—4,100 tonnes of liquid oxygen and 1,150 tonnes of liquid methane at the 3.6-to-1 oxidizer-to-fuel ratio.
claims.source_title: Fuel supply is a bottleneck for Starship—here’s how SpaceX will get around it
claims.supporting_quote: SpaceX lists the current full stack at 124 metres tall, with capacity for 1,600 tonnes of propellant in the upper ship and 3,650 tonnes in Super Heavy. Together that is 5,250 tonnes of liquid methane and liquid oxygen at full capacity.

claims.claim: Scaling to 456 annual Starship launches requires about 2.4 million tonnes of propellant each year.
claims.episode_span: Scaling to 456 annual launches therefore requires about 2.4 million tonnes of propellant each year.
claims.supporting_quote: Each full Starship/Super Heavy stack needs ~5,250 tonnes of methalox (about 4,100 t LOX + 1,150 t liquid methane at the Raptor 3.6:1 ratio). For 456 launches that totals roughly 2.4 million tonnes of propellant yearly.

claims.claim: SpaceX is building air-separation units at Starbase for LOX and using the Starpipe natural-gas pipeline for on-site methane liquefaction.
claims.episode_span: SpaceX is instead siting air-separation units at Starbase to extract oxygen directly from ambient air and routing a natural-gas pipeline, called Starpipe, to on-site liquefaction plants that convert methane feedstock into liquid form.
claims.source_title: Fuel supply is a bottleneck for Starship—here’s how SpaceX will get around it
claims.supporting_quote: SpaceX has built one Starship launch pad and is preparing to activate a second one. With Starship, SpaceX seeks to buck the old way of doing things. Tanker trucks have traditionally delivered rocket propellant to launch pads at America’s busiest spaceports in Florida and California.

claims.claim: Ship 40 is the first Starship to return to its launch site and is now vertical in Megabay 2 at Starbase.
claims.episode_span: The first Starship to return to its launch site, Ship 40's journey took it across air, space, and sea. It will provide first-of-its-kind data on a flown Starship heatshield, Raptor engines, avionics, and more.
claims.source_title: First Starship Returns to Launch Site at Starbase
claims.supporting_quote: The first Starship to return to its launch site, Ship 40's journey took it across air, space, and sea. Now that it is vertical alongside three other Starships in a Megabay at Starbase, it will provide first-of-its-kind data on a flown Starship heatshield, Raptor engines, avionics, and more.
